description: Curated Agent Skills (SKILL.md): structured thinking lenses, decision support, and brainstorming workflows for AI coding agents.

interface.shortDescription: Structured thinking methods for decisions, root causes, risks, and ideas
interface.longDescription: Standalone thinking skills that run a method on a real decision: five whys, pre-mortem, trade-off analysis, prioritization, first principles, six thinking hats, and more. A selector skill picks the right method when you do not know which one fits.
